scripts.text: - after you put some items into kafra storage. -
scripts.translation: - 先把一些物品存进卡普拉仓库。 -

scripts.text: Such a nice day. Days like this are perfect to make dyes.
scripts.translation: 天气真好。这种日子最适合制作染料。

scripts.text: Erm, I don't really have much to say to you. But, if you would like me to tell you about my life, I can do that. It's a little long and boring, but would you like to listen?
scripts.translation: 嗯，我没什么特别想说的。不过，如果你想听听我的人生故事，我可以讲给你听。故事有点长，也有些无聊，你想听吗？

scripts.text: As long as I can remember, my father has been making dyes. He used to spend countless hours making dyes of different colors. Even when my mother passed away, he never stopped.
scripts.translation: 我记事起，父亲就一直在制作染料。他花了无数时间调制各种颜色的染料。即使母亲去世了，他也从未停下。

scripts.text: At one point in my life, I became rebellious and ran away from home. I didn't want to be stuck to the family business and wanted to try other things.
scripts.translation: 人生中的某个时期，我开始叛逆，离家出走。我不想被家族生意束缚，想尝试其他事情。

scripts.text: I eventually wound up back home to carry on the family tradition, making dyes for 15 years already. I guess it was really in my blood.
scripts.translation: 最后我还是回家继承了家业，制作染料已经有15年了。我想这真是流淌在我血液里的东西。

scripts.text: Something I realized these days is that now I can understand my father. Why my father devoted everything to making dyes...
scripts.translation: 最近我明白了一件事：现在我终于理解父亲了。理解他为什么倾尽一切制作染料...

scripts.text: In the middle of all that tedious and hard work, he probably felt the magic of those colors passing on so many dreams for other people.
scripts.translation: 在那些枯燥又辛苦的工作中，他大概感受到了色彩的魔力，能为许多人传递梦想。

scripts.text: It was probably for those dreams that he tried so hard to make dyes for his customers...
scripts.translation: 他那么努力地为顾客制作染料，大概就是为了实现那些梦想...

scripts.text: Heh... How do I know this? Well, that's the way I feel right now. Since a couple years ago, I've been able to hear what the colors were saying...
scripts.translation: 呵...你问我怎么知道？因为我现在也有这种感觉。几年前开始，我就能听见颜色在说话...

scripts.text: Just watch. Someday, I'm going to succeed in making the color my father wanted to, but never got the chance to make.
scripts.translation: 看着吧。总有一天，我会成功调出父亲想做却没能做出来的颜色。

scripts.text: Well, I guess no one would want to listen to a measly dyemaker's story anyway. Hahaha....
scripts.translation: 不过，谁会想听一个小小染料师的故事呢？哈哈哈...

scripts.text: Great! If you want it, I'll make it for you. I promise I'll make you the color you want. But what color dye would you like to make? The fee is different depending on the color.
scripts.translation: 太好了！你想要的话，我就帮你做。我保证会调出你想要的颜色。你想制作哪种染料？不同颜色的费用也不同。

scripts.text: Why, do you ask? Just remember that there are colors that are easy to make, and those that require more effort and work. Please don't think the fee is too expensive.
scripts.translation: 你问为什么？只要记住，有些颜色容易制作，有些则需要更多心力和工夫。别嫌费用太贵哦。

scripts.text: The color of the dye is special, made with all my heart and soul.
scripts.translation: 这种染料的颜色与众不同，是我倾注心血制作的。

scripts.text: Eeeehhhh!! What's this? You change your mind now!? So disappointing...
scripts.translation: 咦——！！怎么回事？你现在改变主意了！？太让人失望了...

scripts.text: I'm not bragging or anything. But I have the skills to make dyestuff. If you ever need dyestuff, please come to me. I'll make them for you at a reasonable price.
scripts.translation: 我不是在自夸，但我确实有制作染料的本事。以后需要染料就来找我，我会以合理的价格帮你制作。

scripts.text: Mmm... I need 30 Red Herbs, 1 Counteragent, and 1 Empty Bottle to make Red Dyestuffs. The fee is only 3000 zeny to make it.
scripts.translation: 嗯...制作红色染料需要30个红色药草、1个中和剂和1个空瓶。费用只要3,000 Zeny。

scripts.text: Mmm... I need 30 Yellow Herbs, 1 Couneragent, and 1 Empty Bottle to make Lemon Dyestuffs. The fee is only 3000 zeny to make it.
scripts.translation: 嗯...制作柠檬色染料需要30个黄色药草、1个中和剂和1个空瓶。费用只要3,000 Zeny。

scripts.text: Mmm... I need 20 Blue Herbs, 1 Counteragent, and 1 Empty Bottle to make Cobaltblue Dyestuff. It's hard to use the Blue Herb, so the fee is going to be 3500 zeny.
scripts.translation: 嗯...制作钴蓝色染料需要20个蓝色药草、1个中和剂和1个空瓶。蓝色药草很难处理，所以费用是3,500 Zeny。

scripts.text: Mmm... I need 5 Blue Herbs, 20 Green Herbs, 20 Yellow Herbs, 1 Counteragent, 1 Mixture, and 1 Empty Bottle to make Darkgreen Dyestuffs. Don't get all of the materials confused. The fee is only 5000 zeny.
scripts.translation: 嗯...制作深绿色染料需要5个蓝色药草、20个绿色药草、20个黄色药草、1个中和剂、1个混合液和1个空瓶。材料别弄混了。费用只要5,000 Zeny。

scripts.text: Mmm... I need 20 Red Herbs, 20 Yellow Herbs, 1 Counteragent, 1 Mixture, and 1 Empty Bottle to make Orange Dyestuff. The fee is going to be 5000 zeny.
scripts.translation: 嗯...制作橙色染料需要20个红色药草、20个黄色药草、1个中和剂、1个混合液和1个空瓶。费用是5,000 Zeny。

scripts.text: Mmm... I need 10 Blue Herbs, 30 Red Herbs, 1 Counteragent, 1 Mixture, and 1 Empty Bottle to make Violet Dyestuffs. The fee will be 5000 zeny.
scripts.translation: 嗯...制作紫色染料需要10个蓝色药草、30个红色药草、1个中和剂、1个混合液和1个空瓶。费用是5,000 Zeny。

scripts.text: Mmm... I need 30 White Herbs, 1 Counteragent, and 1 Empty bottle to make White Dyestuffs. The fee will be 3000 zeny.
scripts.translation: 嗯...制作白色染料需要30个白色药草、1个中和剂和1个空瓶。费用是3,000 Zeny。

scripts.text: Mmm... I need 30 of each Red, Yellow, and Green Herb, 5 Blue Herbs, 1 Counteragent, 1 Mixture, and 1 Empty Bottle. The process takes longer and more effort than the others, so it is going to be 7000 zeny.
scripts.translation: 嗯...需要红色、黄色和绿色药草各30个，蓝色药草5个、1个中和剂、1个混合液和1个空瓶。制作过程比其他染料更费时费力，所以费用是7,000 Zeny。

scripts.text: Ah! I think you would have everything ready. Would you like to start the process?
scripts.translation: 啊！我想你已经准备好所有材料了。要开始制作吗？

scripts.text: Okay! I believe you would have everything ready. Would you like to start the process?
scripts.translation: 好的！我相信你已经准备好所有材料了。要开始制作吗？

scripts.text: Okay! I believe you would have everything ready. Shall we begin the process?
scripts.translation: 好的！我相信你已经准备好所有材料了。我们开始吧？

scripts.text: Okay! I believe you would have everything prepared. Would you like to start the process?
scripts.translation: 好的！我相信你已经准备好所有材料了。要开始制作吗？

scripts.text: I don't think I'll be able to make the color you want with those materials. Why don't you go get some more materials...?
scripts.translation: 这些材料好像做不出你想要的颜色。再去收集一些材料吧...？

scripts.text: Hmm... It came out pretty well. A very rich color. Of course I'll be trying harder to make a more charming color...
scripts.translation: 嗯...做得不错，颜色很浓郁。当然，我会继续努力，调出更迷人的颜色...

scripts.text: Well, then. Stop by whenever you need more dyes.
scripts.translation: 那么，需要染料时随时来找我。

scripts.text: You change your mind now!? So disappointing...
scripts.translation: 你现在改变主意了！？太让人失望了...
